newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slips further.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slips further.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index slipped 1.09 percent, or 0.82 points, to 74.27 on Tuesday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index edged down just over three points to 3,355.27.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market fell to 14.21 percent from Monday 15.23 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
